_comment: CANONICAL VOCABULARY OF app.uncaught_error — the contract between
TelemetryUncaughtErrorCounter and the crux-telemetry ingestion Worker,
which checks this one event's property values against these lists rather
than only against its generic value class.
SOURCE OF TRUTH: the ingestion Worker's own copy of this document, which
its test suite holds its schema to. This file carries the same data;
constants equal it. A change is a change to both sides and must land on
both, Worker first: a value a client sends before the Worker knows it is
'silent' is a boolean and has no list.
